title: Evaluation of the partial complete tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\alpha$, and let $p,x\in\{0,1\}^n$. For a set $I$ of coordinates, suppose $p$ and $x$ agree at every coordinate outside $I$. Then the tree constructed from $f$ with partial input $p$ and available coordinates $I$ evaluates at $x$ to $f(x)$.
